title: Keep SEO landing pages on AnyTour Design System 2.0
goal: Ensure SEO landing templates feel like one AnyTour product rather than a separate legacy SEO site.
rules: Design System 1.0 is not an implementation target.
Reuse the approved DS2 header/footer/components where compatible.
SEO content must not create a second conflicting component system.
Visual work must not silently alter search/Tourvisor/lead contracts.
